item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"C1","claim_type":"core","weight":12,"statement":"When tracing is enabled, each `dspy.Predict` call records a trace entry by appending `(predictor, inputs, Prediction)` to `dspy.settings.trace`.","span_ids":["S1"]},{"claim_id":"C2","claim_type":"core","weight":18,"statement":"`BestOfN.forward` runs every sampled rollout inside `dspy.context(trace=[])`, so each candidate gets a fresh temporary trace instead of directly accumulating into the surrounding trace.","span_ids":["S2"]},{"claim_id":"C3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"In `BestOfN`, the rollout trace is copied before `reward_fn` runs, `best_trace` is updated only for a better reward, and only `best_trace` is extended back at the end; this means the preserved candidate trace is just the current best rollout, not all candidates or reward-function activity.","span_ids":["S2","S3"]},{"claim_id":"C4","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"`Refine.forward` uses the same per-rollout isolation pattern: each candidate runs under `dspy.context(trace=[])`, and that rollout trace is copied before `reward_fn` executes.","span_ids":["S4"]},{"claim_id":"C5","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"In `Refine`, only the rollout stored in `best_trace` is preserved among the sampled candidates, because `best_trace` changes only when `reward > best_reward` and is appended to `dspy.settings.trace` once after the rollout loop.","span_ids":["S5"]},{"claim_id":"C6","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"`Refine` generates feedback with `dspy.Predict(OfferFeedback)` after the temporary rollout-trace block, so these helper predictor calls can appear separately in the final trace even though only one candidate rollout is kept.","span_ids":["S1","S6"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"S1","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":226,"end_line":233},{"span_id":"S2","path":"dspy/predict/best_of_n.py","start_line":61,"end_line":73},{"span_id":"S3","path":"dspy/predict/best_of_n.py","start_line":74,"end_line":88},{"span_id":"S4","path":"dspy/predict/refine.py","start_line":116,"end_line":138},{"span_id":"S5","path":"dspy/predict/refine.py","start_line":139,"end_line":177},{"span_id":"S6","path":"dspy/predict/refine.py","start_line":148,"end_line":167}]}
